# James Web

> James Web is a division of Luminary Technicals, founded by AR. Abhinav Ranjan, focused on legal hacking learning and research. It publishes the James Series of cybersecurity books and a free online reader. Teaching follows a permission-first model: test only systems you own or have explicit authorization to test.

James Web is not affiliated with NASA, ESA, CSA or the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). The similar name is a coincidence.

## Key facts
- Site: https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/
- Parent organization: Luminary Technicals (https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org)
- Publisher imprint: Luminary Books
- Founder and author: AR. Abhinav Ranjan
- Topics: ethical hacking, network security, web security (XSS from a defender's view), Kali Linux, Nmap, digital logic, legal practice labs
- Language: English (India)

## Books
- James Web Logical: A Complete Guide to Ethical Hacking, Tools, Security & Logical Thinking. First Edition, 2026, 24 pages, five chapters plus an introduction. Free to read online in India; $3 USD on Amazon Kindle and Google Play Books worldwide. Page: https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/logical/
- James Web Onion Mode: upcoming, not yet released. No details have been published.

- [Home](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/): overview of the James Series

- [Immersive Reader](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/reader/): free online reader
- [About](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/about/): who runs James Web and how the organization fits together
- [Ethics & Responsible Use](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/ethics/): the permission-first rules and the five-check Legal Lab Checklist
- [Contact](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/contact/): how to reach James Web
- [Privacy](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/privacy/): what the site stores and loads
- [Disclaimer](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/disclaimer/): education-only use, trademarks, external links
- [Corrections](https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/corrections/): corrections policy and dated change log
